full_judgment: 3. The plaintiff's Case (Title Suit No. 44 of 2001) in short is that Arfan Bibi and Ashab Uddin Kazi jointly got settlement of 60 decimals of land in dispute from the ex-landlord. Arfan Bibi died leaving behind only daughter Bodrun Nessa who sold 31 decimals land to Kazi Esmail by a registered deed No.47 dated 22-6-1944. SA Khatian No. 149 was finally published in equal shares in the name of Kazi Esmail and Kazi Mannan. Kazi Esmail gifted 29 decimals land to the petitioner Kazi Harun Mia, who is his grandson, by a registered deed of Gift dated 14-2-1960 including 4 decimals land of Plot No. 783 and he is in possession of the said land and since then the defendant Kazi Abdul Mannan threatened him and thus he (Kazi Harun) filed the instant suit for permanent injunction.
